name: Eagle F1 RS TLR

origin.basis: Goodyear's bicycle-tire line was developed with Rubber Kinetics by a team at Goodyear's Akron, Ohio headquarters (Bicycle Retailer, 2018).

manufacturing.basis: Goodyear does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Goodyear's current Eagle F1 RS road race tire in its tubeless-ready construction, with the UUHP compound.
weight_basis: Goodyear store weights for the tubeless-ready SKUs.

availability.note: Sold by Goodyear Bicycle Tires' US-dollar web store; Goodyear Eagle and Vector tires are sold by Tmall shops in mainland China; European availability not verified in this pass.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; US shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2023 Eagle F1 R test is an earlier generation and is not applied.
A lighter tube-type Eagle F1 RS is sold separately.
